findings.title: action precedence undocumented; four cited cells never execute the named action
findings.evidence: Last arg_action assignment wins: -N :802, -F :806, --list-boots :813, --disk-usage :825, --sync :856, --header :877-878. live_list_boots (--list-boots last) prints the boot list (541 bytes); ext_diskusage_N (-N last) prints field names (2882); ext_header_F (-F last) prints values (12); ext_sync_F (-F last) never runs --sync. Exit 0 stays correct (guard at :958 precedes dispatch) but the rows are not evidence that the field list and the other action both execute. --sync is a write request the tested ordering bypasses; do not generalize read-only safety across ordering.
findings.fix: State last-action-wins precedence and, per cell, which action executed; or reorder argv and record the executed action. Keep -n (truncation) separate from action replacement.
